data.name: House Of Horror: Outside Is Better
data.detailed_description:
HOUSE OF HORROR: OUTSIDE IS BETTER is a first-person psychological survival horror game that immerses players in a chilling horror adventure, designed to push tension, suspense, and mental endurance to the extreme, challenging even the most experienced players of the genre. Prepare to explore a nightmarish torture center overrun by psychiatric patients who exhibit dangerously violent behavior.

This immersive experience delivers a terrifying combination of suspense, horror, and psychological dread, testing the limits of survival in a place where escape feels impossible. Developed by veterans of the horror genre, this game challenges even the most seasoned players.

Set within a psychiatric torture facility transformed into a true nightmare, the game immerses players in a dark, oppressive, and deeply disturbing environment. Through carefully crafted atmospheric and sound-driven horror, every corridor, room, and shadow becomes a constant threat. Every minute is designed to intensify fear and sustain maximum tension.

The experience blends FPS gameplay, escape-room-style challenges, and environmental storytelling, delivering everything expected from this beautiful and unforgiving genre. Players must solve puzzles, manage scarce resources, and survive encounters with extremely violent psychiatric patients, in a place where escape feels impossible and moving forward is the only option.

The story unfolds through episodic adventures, each starring different characters connected to the facility of terror. Every episode offers a unique perspective, introduces new mechanics, and reveals narrative fragments that collectively reconstruct the dark truth hidden behind the institution.

Deep within a secret underground facility, indescribable horrors are unleashed as psychiatric patients, driven to the brink of madness, become violent and uncontrollable. This twisted prison, once a place of human experimentation and torment, has now become your arena for survival.

You awaken with no memory of how you arrived, forced to piece together the horrific experiments and inhumane trials carried out within the facility. As you delve deeper, you uncover a malevolent force lurking behind the madness—an entity that warps reality itself. Surviving this terrible experience will require not only ingenuity, but also your sanity.

Developed by veterans of the horror genre with experience in major entertainment productions, House of Horror: Outside Is Better delivers a solid, immersive survival horror experience carefully crafted to disturb, challenge, and terrify.

  • Use a goal watch as your primary orientation tool within the facility. This device not only guides your objectives and progression, but also functions as a credit system, allowing you to access different resources, unlock rewards, and make strategic decisions that directly impact your survival.

  • To endure this experience, you must rely on a dynamo-powered flashlight—an essential element that reinforces immersion and constant tension. Its use requires careful management, forcing you to choose when to illuminate the darkness and when to move forward blindly, intensifying the psychological horror.

  • Combat follows a survival horror FPS approach, featuring access to a limited arsenal that includes revolvers, shotguns, pistols, and other tools. Every encounter must be carefully assessed, as ammunition is scarce and each decision can mean the difference between survival and death.

  • The game embraces an immersive first-person simulation, blending walking simulator elements, narrative exploration, and atmospheric horror with 3D sound, creating an oppressive and sensory experience where the environment, audio, and constant interaction with the world are just as dangerous as the enemies that inhabit it.

  • True survival horror: at times you will be defenseless—without weapons or allies—leaving you with only the option to flee, hide, and outsmart your twisted captors. At other moments, you will face dynamic and direct confrontations.

  • Psychological horror: experience a disturbing story in which sanity erodes with every revelation, blending terror with mental collapse.

  • Immersive visuals: high-quality graphics draw players into a dark and claustrophobic environment, increasing tension with every step.

  • Unpredictable enemies: psychiatric patients follow no patterns—they may stalk you silently or erupt into violent attacks at any moment.

  • Dark themes: themes of psychological abuse, torture, and madness play a prominent role, creating a deeply unsettling atmosphere throughout the game.

HOUSE OF HORROR: OUTSIDE IS BETTER" contains graphic violence, disturbing imagery, moments of nudity, and intense psychological themes. Viewer discretion is strongly advised. The game also includes scenes that may trigger photosensitivity. Any resemblance to real events or people is purely coincidental.

data.short_description: House of Horror: Outside Is Better is a first-person psychological survival horror game with FPS mechanics. Explore a facility consumed by madness, solve puzzles, manage scarce resources, and survive using your wits and a dynamo-powered flashlight, where every shadow can become a deadly threat.
